sources.title: MedGemma — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Accelerate the development of healthcare-based AI applications MedGemma 1.5 4B enables developers to more effectively adapt MedGemma for applications that involve high-dimensional imaging (CT, MRI, and whole slide histopathology), longitudinal analysis of chest X-rays, anatomical localization, and other medical imaging and text functionality.

sources.title: medgemma-1.5-4b-it: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview medgemma-1.5-4b-it is a 4-billion-parameter multimodal instruction-tuned model built by google that combines medical imaging and text understanding for healthcare applications. The model processes both images and text, generating text-only outputs up to 8,192 tokens using a decoder-only transformer architecture with grouped-query attention and support for at least 128K token context ...
